findings.passage: I voted to cement Voter ID in the Wisconsin Constitution because it helps prevent voter fraud. Showing your ID in order to vote is just plain common sense. Furthermore, it strengthens public confidence in the integrity and the legitimacy of our elections.
findings.note: Statement after supporting Senate Joint Resolution 2, the constitutional amendment to require valid photographic identification when voting.

findings.passage: “For those who say we don’t need this, the very fact we have to have this debate, and the fact that the vote falls along partisan lines, shows Voter ID needs to be protected, through the use of a Constitutional amendment.”
findings.note: Same statement; answers people who say the amendment is not needed.
